result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active unmatched contributors. Dormant ones are left out. The change is one condition in `getAllTeams()`:

**Change:** `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`, around line 747. The remainder check now also requires `noLatestCommitDate || contributor.getContributor().isActive()`. A blank latest-commit date counts as active, so those contributors stay in. Configured teams are untouched, since the check only sits on the unmatched branch.

**Verification:** The `codeanalyzer` module builds offline and all 330 tests pass (3 skipped, as before). No test covers the landscape team grouping, so this change has no direct test. I did not add one.

Nothing is committed.
